---
title: "Vignettes"
toc: false
---

The book is accompanied by three vignettes that provide hands-on documentation for the `PCRA` R package and its data. Click any title below to view the vignette PDF.

## Current vignettes

```{=html}
<div class="vignette-list">

  <div class="vignette-item">
    <div class="vignette-label">Vignette 1</div>
    <div class="vignette-title"><a href="vignette-1.html">RPCRA Package and Data Overview</a></div>
    <p class="vignette-desc">
      Structure and contents of the <code>PCRA</code> package: the 31 included data sets,
      the two package versions (CRAN and development), <code>data.table</code> basics, the
      CRSP and SPGMI datasets, and the non-open-source data policy.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="vignette-item">
    <div class="vignette-label">Vignette 2</div>
    <div class="vignette-title"><a href="vignette-2.html">CRSP Stocks and SPGMI Factors</a></div>
    <p class="vignette-desc">
      Deep dive into <code>stocksCRSPmonthly</code> and <code>factorsSPGMI</code>: data structure,
      monthly, weekly and daily CRSP data, monthly SPGMI factor exposures, the
      <code>selectCRSPandSPGMI</code> function, <code>xts</code> time series manipulation,
      sector/capitalization subsetting.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="vignette-item">
    <div class="vignette-label">Vignette 3</div>
    <div class="vignette-title"><a href="vignette-3.html">RPCRA Reproducibility</a></div>
    <p class="vignette-desc">
      How to access and run the demo R scripts that reproduce most of the figures
      and tables in the chapters: the <code>demo()</code> command, copy/paste workflow,
      sourcing with <code>rstudioapi</code>, character of the scripts, and setup of
      <code>devtools</code> and Rtools.
    </p>
  </div>

</div>
```
